title: Checkbox
description: A checkbox input component with label, description, indeterminate state, and validation support.

label.description: React.ReactNode — Text label rendered beside the checkbox.

description.description: React.ReactNode — Helper text rendered below the label.

defaultChecked.description: Initial checked state for uncontrolled usage.

indeterminate.description: Displays the indeterminate (minus) indicator instead of a checkmark.

onValueChange.description: (checked: boolean) => void — Fires when the checked state changes.

onCheckedChange.description: (checked: boolean) => void — Deprecated: use onValueChange instead.

error.description: Displays the checkbox in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Error message displayed below the checkbox.

success.description: Displays the checkbox in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Success message displayed below the checkbox.

loading.description: Displays the checkbox in a loading state.

checkedIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Custom icon for the checked state.

uncheckedIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Custom icon for the unchecked state.

indeterminateIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Custom icon for the indeterminate state.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for checkbox sub-elements.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting.
